en.t: St. George Church and Name of Mary (Croatian: Župna crkva sv. Jurja mučenika i Imena Marijina u Odri) is a Catholic parish church located in the neighbourhood Odra of Zagreb, Croatia. The church was built gradually from 1749 to 1780.

hr.t: Župna crkva sv. Jurja mučenika i Imena Marijina katolička je crkva koja je bila građena postupno od 1749. do 1780. godine.

en.t: Church of the Holy Spirit, Zagreb (Croatian: Župna crkva Duha Svetoga u Zagrebu) is a Catholic parish church located in the neighbourhood Jarun of Zagreb, Croatia.

hr.t: Župna crkva Duha Svetoga u Zagrebu katolička je crkva sagrađena 1982. godine na zagrebačkom Jarunu, u Dugoratskoj ulici.

en.t: The Esplanade Zagreb Hotel is a historic luxury hotel in Zagreb, Croatia. Located on Starčević Square, it's the first luxury hotel in Croatia and one of Zagreb's main landmarks.

hr.t: Hotel Esplanade je hotel u Zagrebu. Sagrađen je 1925. godine s ciljem pružanja smještaja putnicima glasovitog vlaka Orient Express, koji je prometovao na liniji Pariz – Istanbul.
